. Graham
crackers are considered a whole grain, so this is one tasty way to boost your whole grain intake.
2 graham cracker squares
1 teaspoon 
(5 g) 
low fat cream cheese
1 teaspoon 
(5 g) 
jam
Optional:
sprinkling of cinnamon
1. Spread one graham cracker with low fat cream cheese.
2. Add the jam; sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired.
3. Top with the second graham cracker, making into a sandwich. Enjoy!
Yield: 
1 snackwich
Nutritional Information:
Total calories: 
90 (if you can eat just one!)
Carbohydrate: 
16 g
Protein: 
2 g
Fat 
2 g
